title: Impact - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka Energy's verified impact: 130 MW generation foundation, 1,200t CO2 avoided, 500+ households powered, women-led operations. IoT-tracked ESG metrics across economic, environmental, and social pillars in Burkina Faso.

sections.heading: Measurable from day one
sections.body: BaSuka Energy is a data driven infrastructure company. Every target below is IoT-verified and tracked in real time – giving investors and climate partners high-fidelity ESG metrics in the Sahel.

sections.eyebrow: YEAR 3 TARGETS – GOALS, NOT CURRENT FIGURES
sections.heading: Three Pillars of Verified Impact
sections.intro: All figures are Year 3 programme targets. BaSuka’s IoT-enabled SIRA™ batteries generate real-time, verifiable data from launch day.

sections.heading: Built around global goals
sections.intro: BaSuka directly addresses four UN Sustainable Development Goals through its core operating model – not as a CSR add-on, but as the architecture of the business itself.

items.title: Gender equality
items.body: 100% women-led station management. Certified Yennenga Warriors earn 2-3× the local minimum wage through performance-linked pay.

items.title: Affordable & clean energy
items.body: A generation-first foundation of 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity, plus solar-first Swap & Glow™ stations delivering clean electricity where the national grid fails.

items.title: Decent work & economic growth
items.body: 200+ jobs created. $10M+ local economic activity. An infrastructure model designed to retain talent at above-market wages.

items.title: Climate action
items.body: 1,200 tonnes of CO₂ avoided annually by displacing fossil-fuel two-wheel and three-wheel mobility across Burkina Faso.

sections.heading: Path to scale
sections.intro: From pilot launch to a 50-station network – how BaSuka builds verified impact over three years.

items.title: Pilot launch — Ouagadougou
items.body: First Swap & Glow™ stations go live. First Yennenga Warriors cohort deployed. IoT data collection begins on day one.

items.title: Year 1 — Network validation
items.body: 10 stations. 60+ Yennenga Warriors. 2,500+ riders served. First independent CO₂ baseline audit.

items.title: Year 2 — Regional expansion
items.body: 25 stations across 3 cities . 400+ women trained . $3M+ local economic activity milestone reached.

items.title: Year 3 — Full-scale impact
items.body: 50 stations. 1,000+ women trained. 1,200t CO₂ avoided. $10M+ economic activity. 15,000+ riders served.

sections.heading: IoT-verified impact data, ready for your ESG portfolio
sections.body: BaSuka’s SIRA™ smart batteries generate real-time metrics on energy throughput, carbon displacement, and station performance – blockchain – ready and auditable from day one of operations.
